title: A Sky Full of Stars
exercise_name: A Sky Full of Stars · Listening & Vocabulary
description: 《A Sky Full Of Stars》描寫一份充滿希望、光芒與無私付出的深刻愛情。歌中的主角將心愛的人比喻為佈滿星星的天空，因為對方就像黑暗中的星光，照亮了他的人生，帶來溫暖與方向。即使愛情可能伴隨傷害與痛苦，他仍然願意毫無保留地交出自己的真心，勇敢去愛。他相信無論生活變得多麼艱難，對方的存在都能讓世界重新充滿光明。歌曲亦表達了對愛人的欣賞與珍惜，彷彿她是生命中最美麗的風景。最終，《A Sky Full Of Stars》傳達的是愛情中的希望、勇氣與奉獻：真正深刻的愛能在最黑暗的時刻，成為照亮人生的力量。

vocabulary.usage: 形容一個地方或東西有很多某種事物。
options: My bag is full of books, so it is heavy.
My bag full of is books.
I full of to school every day.
The cat is full of at seven.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：full of 後面接名詞，表示書包裡裝滿書。
optionExplanations: 正確：full of 後面接名詞，表示書包裡裝滿書。
錯誤：full of 的位置不對；應說 My bag is full of books.
錯誤：full of 不是「去」的意思；應說 I go to school every day.
錯誤：full of 後面不能直接接 at seven；可以說 The cat is full of energy.

vocabulary.meaning: 將要、打算（going to 的口語說法）
vocabulary.usage: 用在聊天或歌曲中，說自己接下來打算做的事；正式寫作宜用 going to。
options: I gonna my homework after dinner.
We are gonna watch a movie tonight.
She is gonna goes home now.
My sandwich is gonna very happy.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：be gonna 加原形動詞，表示今晚打算看電影。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：gonna 後面需要動詞；應說 I am gonna do my homework.
正確：be gonna 加原形動詞，表示今晚打算看電影。
錯誤：gonna 後面要用原形動詞 go，不是 goes。
錯誤：gonna 後面不能直接接形容詞；應說 My sandwich is going to be very big.

vocabulary.usage: 燈光照亮房間或道路時使用，也可比喻讓人開心。
options: I light up my shoes with a spoon.
The small lamp lights up my room.
She light up to the bus at eight.
The dark turns light up my coffee.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：湯匙不能照亮鞋子；可說 I clean my shoes with a cloth.
正確：小燈讓房間變亮。
錯誤：light up 不是搭車；應說 She takes the bus at eight.
錯誤：句子結構與意思不自然；可以說 The lamp lights up the table.

vocabulary.usage: 當某件事對你不重要，或你不介意某個選擇時使用；語氣有時可能顯得直接。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「I don't care」？
options: I don't care my bag on the chair.
I don't care to blue the sky.
You can choose the red cup or the blue cup. I don't care.
I don't care is seven o'clock.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：兩個杯子選哪個都可以，表示不介意。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：care 不能這樣直接接物品；若要說放包包，可說 I put my bag on the chair.
錯誤：blue 不是這裡可用的動詞；可以說 I don't care if the sky is grey.
正確：兩個杯子選哪個都可以，表示不介意。
錯誤：缺少 if 或 that 等連接方式；可說 I don't care if it is late.

vocabulary.usage: 鼓勵別人接著說、接著做，或表示某件事持續發生。
options: Go on the window because it is cold.
I go on my pizza with cheese.
She goes on a happy yesterday.
Please go on. I want to hear the end of your story.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：go on 表示請繼續說下去。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：這裡應使用 close the window，而不是 go on the window.
錯誤：go on 不能用來表示把起司加到披薩上；應說 I put cheese on my pizza.
錯誤：go on 後面不能這樣接形容詞和 yesterday；可說 She was happy yesterday.
正確：go on 表示請繼續說下去。

vocabulary.meaning: 撕開、撕碎；使人非常難過
vocabulary.usage: 可用於撕壞紙張，也可比喻讓一個人的心情很痛苦。
options: The child tore the old paper apart.
He tears apart the music with his ears.
I tear apart the water to drink it.
She tear apart to the library.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：tore 是 tear 的過去式，表示把紙撕開。
optionExplanations: 正確：tore 是 tear 的過去式，表示把紙撕開。
錯誤：聽音樂不使用 tear apart；應說 He listens to music.
錯誤：水不能被「撕開」；應說 I drink the water.
錯誤：tear apart 不是前往某地；應說 She goes to the library.

vocabulary.usage: 形容一個人被另一個人抱住，常見於親密或安慰的情境。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「in your arms」？
options: My phone is in your arms at six o’clock.
We eat in your arms a big dinner.
I walk in your arms to the shop alone.
The baby is sleeping in her dad’s arms.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：寶寶在爸爸懷裡睡覺。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：時間與情境不自然；說手機被拿著可以用 You are holding my phone.
錯誤：吃晚餐不使用 in your arms；可說 We eat dinner together.
錯誤：一個人走去商店，不適合用 in your arms；應說 I walk to the shop alone.
正確：寶寶在爸爸懷裡睡覺。

vocabulary.usage: 用來說兩件事會一起改變；也常說 the more..., the better...。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「the more..., the more...」？
options: The more I sleep, the more my pencil is blue.
The more I practise, the better I get.
I the more study, the more English.
The more eat I, the more happy.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：練習越多，就進步越多。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：睡眠與鉛筆顏色沒有合理的關係，無法清楚表達一起變化。
正確：練習越多，就進步越多。
錯誤：缺少完整子句；可以說 The more I study, the more I learn.
錯誤：語序不對；可以說 The more I eat, the happier I feel.

vocabulary.usage: 放在形容詞加單數可數名詞之前，加強讚美或驚訝的語氣。
options: I such a go home now.
She is such a very happily.
It is such a beautiful day!
These are such a nice shoes.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：such a 後接 beautiful day，表示今天真美好。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：such a 不能用在 go home 前；應說 I go home now.
錯誤：such a 後面需要單數可數名詞，happily 是副詞。
正確：such a 後接 beautiful day，表示今天真美好。
錯誤：shoes 是複數，要用 such nice shoes，不用 a。

vocabulary.usage: 讚美風景、食物或聲音非常美好時使用。這個字較進階，但例句保持簡單。
options: I heavenly my lunch at school.
He goes heavenly to work at eight.
This heavenly is my new red bag.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：形容蛋糕美味得像天堂一般。
optionExplanations: 正確：形容蛋糕美味得像天堂一般。
錯誤：heavenly 是形容詞，不是「吃」的動詞；應說 I eat lunch at school.
錯誤：heavenly 不用來表示去上班；應說 He goes to work at eight.
錯誤：heavenly 不能單獨當成這裡的名詞；可說 This is my beautiful new red bag.
